assertion.statement: At each finite Artin coefficient stage, flat continuous cochains with finite bounded residual cohomology admit a bounded finite free model with actual inclusion, projection and contraction. For one fixed support/family with bounded model ranks, one ultrafilter retains all specified finite diagram identities overLambda.
assertion.objects: The actual continuous cochains, local-condition maps, duality maps, homotopy inverses and higher compatibility homotopies; finite free models and mapsi,p,h.
assertion.hypotheses: The coefficient ring is Artin local with nilpotent maximal ideal; cochains are flat and residual cohomology finite and bounded. Fix one finite diagram and one support/family whose model ranks are bounded across coefficient stages.
assertion.quantifiers: Every finite coefficient stage satisfying those conditions; every fixed finite diagram; all coefficient precisions for that one retained support/family.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite coefficient Artin rings first; Lambda only after the specified inner limit.
assertion.uniformity: No model-rank bound uniform over all active supports is claimed. The fixed ultrafilter is common to the retained finite tuple.
assertion.constants: Nilpotence makes (1+h0*epsilon)^(-1) and (1+epsilon*h0)^(-1) finite geometric series.
assertion.normalizations: Normalized residual contraction p0i0=1,h0^2=h0i0=p0h0=0; retain pi=1 and1-ip=dh+hd. Maps transport as p_prime*f*i with actual compatibility homotopies.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Stagewise quasi-isomorphisms alone are insufficient for later nonflat coefficient change. Residual finiteness/boundedness and rank bounds are hypotheses still supplied by the arithmetic/cohomological argument.
assertion.limit_order: Split the residual complex, lift bases, apply nilpotent perturbation to construct actual maps/homotopies, retain the fixed finite diagram, then fix ranks along one ultrafilter and take compatible finite-precision matrix limits.
